how: The team, shown on the front page (the cover), on the blog (The team page and every page's footer) and in the readme. One entry per person, in the order to show them. linkedin, role, bio and photo (a copy in app/web/team/) are optional; the blog's team page shows them. While members is empty, no team section appears anywhere. Team members send their details with the form at site/team-form/; cd app && ./demo.sh team adds them here. After editing: cd app && ./demo.sh site

members.name: Victor Saly
members.bio: Victor is a software engineer at Storm Software Systems in Watford, with a long background in .NET web development, search and content platforms. He is a certified Umbraco Expert and Elasticsearch Engineer. Lately he has moved into AI products: he holds Microsoft's AI Product Manager certificate and completed London Business School's Implementing Generative AI course. On this project he built the agent, the site and the tooling behind them.
